items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Andy decided to use me for that theatre date, so I put me on a little miniature piano and had Jack on a big Steinway... I jumped on the big piano and started playing.

ctx.x: Mary, if you all these years have been breaking it up on this basis of being called in specially, why did they never put you on a regular basis?

Well, because they had this pianist. They respected him. Jack was a nice guy. Number one, Jack - I don't know his name - Jack Somebody. He was a good man and everything. It may have been that they didn't want a woman in the band because women during that era was not playing with men. That was another thing that made people scream and carry on, because they saw a woman and one that weighed 90 pounds. My feet was just barely touching the floor.
